_note: SYNTHETIC. The session-activity.py --json shape that scripts/park-nudge.py consumes, and the row shapes it must tell apart. bborbe/claude-supervisor is a PUBLIC repo, so the real rows that motivated this (a 31-minute and a 12-minute `watching` session, measured 2026-11-03, and a session parked 3 h 34 m across 20+ watcher re-arms, measured 2026-11-06) stay in the private task file; every id and name below is invented. `threshold` holds the two `watching` rows either side of the 15-minute line; `buckets` holds one row per non-`watching` bucket, every one ABOVE the threshold, so only bucket exclusion (not a duration filter) can keep them silent. `divergent` is the re-arm case: `quiet_min` 12 (the transcript was touched 12 minutes ago by a re-arm) against `watching_min` 214 (the wait itself began 3 h 34 m ago) — the selection must follow the second, or the session is never nudged. `stale_transcript` is the mirror case SC2 needs: an over-threshold row beside a `watching` session whose transcript is 99 minutes old but whose wait began only 12 minutes ago — it must stay silent, so a stale transcript alone never nudges.
